# SPE Round 5 Plan: Sonnet 6 vs pinned Sonnet 5.5

## Specify

| ID | Requirement | Source | Test |

| R1 | Keep C2 on the pinned dated Sonnet 5.5 id as the reference config. | Decision (new-model rule) | The config file shows the same model id as spe-r04. |
| R2 | Add C2-S6. It is C2 with only the model id changed to the pinned dated Sonnet 6 id. | User: "Sonnet 6 just shipped." | A diff of C2 against C2-S6 shows one line, the model id. |
| R3 | Use the same 40 tickets and the same graders as r04. | Decision | The task and grader file hashes match the spe-r04 tag. |
| R4 | Production does not change during the round. | Decision (new-model rule) | The production config is unchanged at close-out. |
| R5 | Report category_acc, priority_acc, cost, tokens, and seconds per ticket for both configs. | Decision | The synthesis table has all 10 cells filled. |
| R6 | Trials may not read graders, reference labels, or predictions. | Decision (answer-key rule) | A transcript scan finds no reads of `spe/evals/` or `spe/predictions/`. Any trial that read them is voided. |
| R7 | The round number comes from a `ROUND` constant only. | Decision | Running grep on `r05-workflow.js` finds no round number written by hand in the prompt text. |

**Last round's proposals:** I defer every r04 proposal in `spe/failures.md` to r06. Each config may change only one thing. This round tests only the model.

**Default I chose:** I will read the exact dated Sonnet 6 id from the Models API at gate 0 and pin it in C2-S6. I will not use an alias.

## Predict

The bands for tokens and seconds were not in the draft. I chose ±1000 tokens and ±1.5 s for the reference config. One ticket out of 40 equals 0.025 accuracy.

| Metric | C2 (Sonnet 5.5) | C2-S6 (Sonnet 6) | Why | Grader check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| category_acc | 0.89 ± 0.04 | 0.90 ± 0.05 | C2 is the same as last round. Category is already high, so I expect at most a 1-ticket gain. The band is wider because Sonnet 6 has no data yet. | Exact match against the reference category |
| priority_acc | 0.81 ± 0.05 | 0.83 ± 0.06 | Priority needs the most judgment, so a newer model has the most room to gain here. The band is wider because there is no prior data. | Exact match against the reference P1 to P4 |
| cost_per_ticket | 0.006 ± 0.001 | 0.006 ± 0.002 | This assumes Sonnet 6 has the same per-token price as Sonnet 5.5. Before I write the yaml, I check the pricing page and recompute this cell if the price is different. | API usage multiplied by the price table |
| tokens_per_ticket | 9100 ± 1000 | 9100 ± 1500 | Prompt and tools are unchanged. A new model may call tools or write replies at a different length. | Sum of API usage per trial |
| seconds_per_ticket | 7.4 ± 1.5 | 7.4 ± 2.0 | Latency often varies in launch week. | Wall clock per completed trial |

## Evaluate

**Gates, in order. Any failure halts the round and I report it.**
0. Confirm the pinned Sonnet 6 dated id and its price. Record both in the config.
1. Grader selftest. The oracle answers must pass. The empty and wrong answers must fail.
2. Control. Regrade the r04 results with the r05 graders. The scores must match r04 exactly. Any change means the grader changed.
3. Dry run with `args.only` on 3 cells: 1 ticket under C2 and 2 tickets under C2-S6. Each result must validate against the trial schema.

**Script:** `spe/evals/harness/r05-workflow.js`, copied from r04. The phases are Trials, Grade, Top-up, Synthesis, a failure-analysis agent, and a completeness critic. Code checks grade category and priority, so this round needs no judge.

**Workflow arguments:**
- `ROUND: 5`
- `configs: ["C2-sonnet-5-5", "C2-sonnet-6"]`
- `tasks: 40`
- `trialsPerCell: 3`
- `topUpCap: 2` extra trials, only for cells where some trials passed and some failed
- `apiSpendCapUSD: 5`
- `maxAgents: 300`
- `readablePaths`: the ticket inputs and the triage agent source only

**Measure:** accuracy, runtime, tool calls, tokens, and tool errors per trial. I count completed trials only. Harness errors and rate limits are logged apart from model failures.

**Cost estimate (unmeasured):** about 240 trials at about $0.006 each comes to about $1.50. Top-up and the analysis agents add about $1. The total is about $2.50, under the $5 cap. Wall time is about 30 minutes if the trials run serially.

**Close-out:** I compare results to `spe/predictions/r05.yaml`, log any misses in `spe/failures.md`, and make a local commit. A production switch to Sonnet 6 is a decision only you can make, so I report the results and stop there.
